history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young person in a black t-shirt is sitting in a dark room, holding a smartphone and looking down at it. To their left, a gaming setup is illuminated by vibrant RGB lighting. A computer monitor displays a colorful interface, and a mechanical keyboard with glowing keys sits in front of it. Beside the monitor is a custom-built PC tower, its glass side panel revealing internal components bathed in a spectrum of purple, pink, and blue lights. The overall mood is one of focused engagement, with the artificial glow of the electronics creating a futuristic and immersive atmosphere. The lighting is dramatic and moody, with strong contrasts between the illuminated areas and the dark background, emphasizing the glow of the RGB components. The color palette is dominated by deep blues, purples, and pinks from the lighting, contrasted with the black of the clothing, furniture, and shadows. The style is modern and tech-oriented, capturing a moment of digital immersion.
